title: 第29章 拍卖会（一）
novel_title: 苟道剑尊：从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
离开万鬼楼后，陈凡并未在鬼市多做停留。

    他在万鬼楼势力庇护的一处地下溶洞内，花费了几块灵石租下一间带有微型防御阵法的隐蔽密室，又给老鬼留下一枚特制的通信符，便在密室中打坐静候。

    这一个月间，万鬼楼陆陆续续送来几批残破的一阶极品法器。

    陈凡靠着筑基期的浑厚神识与精准的控火手段，几乎不费吹灰之力便将其修补完成，既赚取了数额不菲的灵石，更通过老鬼的内部暗线，将本次万宝拍卖会的底细摸了个七七八八。

    一个月后，万宝拍卖会如期而至。

    临泉郡鬼市核心区，一座由白玉巨石砌筑而成的庞大阁楼拔地而起。

    阁楼上方挂着一块描金牌匾，上书“万宝楼”三个大字。

    陈凡摘下了平日里招摇的白骨令牌，催动胸前的匿息佩，将浑身修为波动压制在炼气九层。

    同时，他拍上一张易容符，将那张蜡黄面容拉伸，化作一名面色枯槁、眼神阴鸷的中年散修。

    他顺着涌动的黑衣人流走向万宝楼大门。

    大门口，两名散发着筑基初期强横气息的万宝楼护卫面色冷峻。

    任何想要入场的修士，都必须在前台接受盘查。

    “入场费，五十下品灵石。”

    负责登记的万宝楼执事声音冷淡，头也不抬。

    五十块下品灵石，对寻常炼气后期散修而言已是一笔不小的开支。

    不少人在听到这个数字后皆面露肉痛，但想到里面可能出现的机缘，还是咬牙掏了灵石。

    陈凡面无表情，从腰间的普通储物袋中摸出五十块灵石扔在桌上，接过一块刻有数字“三百四十七”的玄铁令牌，迈步跨入大门。

    万宝拍卖会共分三层。

    第一层专供炼气期，第二层则是筑基期，第三层则是神秘的贵宾区。

    陈凡如今明面上的伪装是炼气九层，自然只能停留在第一层的大厅中。

    大厅呈半圆形，中央是一座白玉砌筑的高台。

    陈凡顺着令牌上的编号，找到了位于后排靠墙的一个偏僻座位。

    这里位置极偏，但胜在靠近安全出口。

    “铛——”

    一炷香后，一声悠扬的玉磬之声在厅内荡漾开来。

    白玉高台上，阵法光幕微微闪烁。

    一名身着蓝色锦袍、面色红润的筑基中期老者缓步走到台前，声音夹杂着雄浑法力清晰传遍全场：

    “诸位道友，老夫万宝楼执事刘崇。本届万宝拍卖会现在开始。价高者得，若有灵石不足者，可以当场以同等价值的灵物抵扣。”

    筑基中期的威压一放即收，台下不少炼气期修士皆是脸色一白。

    “第一件拍品，一阶上品防御法器，八卦玄龟盾，起拍价一百灵石……”

    拍卖会的气氛很快便被调动起来。

    符箓、丹药、一阶法器层出不穷，场内的叫价声此起彼伏。

    陈凡冷眼旁观，始终不曾出价。

    直到第七件拍品呈上来。

    “二阶低等奇珍，二阶庚金精魄。”

    刘崇揭开红绸，托盘中央静静躺着一块拇指大小、通体呈现暗金之色的晶体。

    这晶体刚一暴露在空气中，虚空中便隐隐传来了阵阵锋锐至极的破空声。

    “此物乃罕见的天地金属性灵气汇聚而成，坚硬无比，自带一丝庚金锐气。起拍价，两百下品灵石。”

    陈凡藏在袖中的右手指尖微微一颤。

    膝头纳着的金螭剑已经在储物袋中隐隐发出低鸣。

    金螭剑若想跨过天堑晋升为二阶下品法器，这庚金精魄便是核心引子。

    此物，他志在必得！

    “两百一十块灵石！”

    “两百五十块！”

    场内的价格一路飙升。

    前方一处贵宾席位上，正坐着一名身穿白衣、怀中抱着一柄长剑的年轻修士。

    此人神色倨傲，浑身散发着淡淡的剑气。

    陈凡强悍的神识微微一扫，便看穿了对方的底细——筑基初期，一名剑修。

    “五百灵石。”

    白衣剑修淡淡开口，声音不大，却透着一股不容置疑的傲然。
content_en:
After leaving Wangui Tower, Chen Fan did not stay in the ghost market for much.

    He spent a few spiritual stones to rent a hidden secret room with a miniature defense formation in an underground cave protected by the Wangui Tower. He also left a special communication talisman for the old ghost, and then he meditated in the secret room and waited.

    In the past month, Wangui Tower has sent several batches of broken first-class magic weapons one after another.

    Relying on his profound consciousness and precise fire control methods in the foundation building stage, Chen Fan repaired it with almost no effort. Not only did he earn a large amount of spiritual stones, but he also figured out the details of this Wanbao auction through the old ghost's internal secrets.

    A month later, the Wanbao auction came as scheduled.

    In the core area of ​​Linquan County Ghost City, a huge attic made of white jade boulders rises from the ground.

    There is a gold-plated plaque hanging above the attic, with the three characters "Wanbao Tower" written on it.

    Chen Fan took off the bone token that he usually showed off, activated the breath-hiding pendant on his chest, and suppressed all the fluctuations in his cultivation to the ninth level of Qi refining.

    At the same time, he took a disguise and stretched the sallow face, turning it into a middle-aged casual cultivator with a haggard face and sinister eyes.

    He followed the surging flow of people in black towards the gate of Wanbao Tower.

    At the gate, two Wanbao Tower guards who exuded a tyrannical aura in the early stages of foundation building looked stern.

    Any monk who wishes to enter must be questioned at the front desk.

    "The entrance fee is fifty low-grade spiritual stones."

    The deacon of Wanbaolou who was responsible for the registration had a cold voice and did not even raise his head.

    Fifty pieces of low-grade spiritual stones are already a considerable expense for ordinary casual practitioners in the late stage of Qi refining.

    Many people felt heartbroken after hearing this number, but thinking of the opportunities that might appear in it, they gritted their teeth and took out the spirit stones.

    Chen Fan had no expression on his face. He took out fifty spiritual stones from the ordinary storage bag on his waist and threw them on the table. He took a black iron token engraved with the number "three hundred and forty-seven" and stepped into the door.

    Wanbao Auction is divided into three floors.

    The first floor is dedicated to the Qi refining period, the second floor is the foundation building period, and the third floor is the mysterious VIP area.

    Chen Fan is currently pretending to be on the ninth level of Qi Refining, so naturally he can only stay in the hall on the first level.

    The hall is semicircular, with a high platform made of white jade in the center.

    Chen Fan followed the number on the token and found a remote seat in the back row against the wall.

    The location here is extremely remote, but the advantage is that it is close to the safety exit.

    "Dang——"

    After burning a stick of incense, a melodious sound of a jade chime rippled through the hall.

    On the white jade high platform, the array light curtain flickered slightly.

    An old man in the middle stage of foundation building, wearing a blue brocade robe and a rosy complexion, walked slowly to the front of the stage. His voice mixed with powerful mana clearly spread throughout the audience:

    "Fellow Taoists, I am Liu Chong, the deacon of Wanbao Tower. This Wanbao auction begins now. The one with the highest price will get it. If there are insufficient spiritual stones, they can be deducted with spiritual objects of the same value on the spot."

    The pressure in the middle stage of Foundation Establishment was as soon as it was released, and many monks in the Qi Refining Stage in the audience turned pale.

    "The first auction item is a first-class high-grade defensive weapon, the Bagua Black Turtle Shield. The starting price is one hundred spirit stones..."

    The atmosphere of the auction was quickly aroused.

    Talismans, elixirs, and first-level magic weapons appeared one after another, and biddings were heard one after another in the venue.

    Chen Fan watched with cold eyes and never made a bid.

    Until the seventh lot was presented.

    "Second-level low-level rare treasures, second-level Gengjin essence."

    Liu Chong uncovered the red silk and found a thumb-sized crystal with a dark golden color lying quietly in the center of the tray.

    As soon as the crystal was exposed to the air, bursts of extremely sharp sound of breaking through the air were faintly heard in the void.

    "This object is made from the rare metallic aura of heaven and earth. It is extremely hard and has a hint of Gengjin aura. The starting price is two hundred low-grade spiritual stones."

    The fingertips of Chen Fan's right hand hidden in his sleeve trembled slightly.

    The golden chi sword held in his lap was already humming faintly in the storage bag.

    If the Golden Chi Sword wants to cross the chasm and be promoted to a second-level low-grade magic weapon, this Gengjin spirit is the core introduction.

    He is determined to get this thing!

    "Two hundred and ten spiritual stones!"

    "Two hundred and fifty dollars!"

    Prices on the floor soared.

    Sitting on a VIP seat in front was a young monk wearing white clothes and holding a long sword in his arms.

    This man looked arrogant and exuded a faint sword aura.

    Chen Fan's powerful spiritual consciousness glanced slightly, and he saw through the opponent's background - a sword cultivator in the early stage of foundation building.

    "Five hundred spirit stones."

    The white-clothed swordsman spoke calmly, his voice was not loud, but there was an unquestionable pride.
